name: Biomedical Engineering
description: Biomedical engineering programmes apply engineering to medicine — instrumentation and imaging, biomaterials and implants, biomechanics, and tissue and neural engineering. It is Florida’s newest and fastest-growing engineering discipline. ⚠⚠ It is also the one where the bachelor’s degree is least often the end of the story: fewer than half of employers treat it as sufficient, and two Florida universities award the degree at graduate level only.
degreesNote: The programme and the major are the same thing: a Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it. Some programmes brand it bioengineering, which is the same degree. ⚠⚠ UNLIKE MOST PROGRAMMES IN THIS REPOSITORY, THE GRADUATE DEGREES ARE NOT OPTIONAL EXTRAS — UCF and FAU offer them without any bachelor’s, and O*NET reports 26% of employers requiring a master’s and 13% a doctorate. ⚠ Check ABET accreditation under the ENGINEERING commission, not engineering technology.

cips.note: Biomedical/Medical Engineering — the degree itself. All Florida awards fall under 14.0501.
General engineering, where several Florida institutions place a first year common to all engineering majors.
